verses.text_uthmani: ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُونَ

translations.text: Ever closer to people draws their reckoning, while they turn away, heedless.
Qareeb aa gaya hai logon ke hisaab ka waqt, aur woh hain ke gaflat mein mooh moadey huey hain

verses.text_uthmani: مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ

translations.text: Whenever any fresh revelation comes to them from their Lord, they listen to it playfully
Unke paas jo taaza naseehat bhi unke Rubb ki taraf se aati hai usko be-takalluf sunte hain aur khel mein padey rehte hain

verses.text_uthmani: لَاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ هَلْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ ۖ أَفَتَأْتُونَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ

translations.text: with frivolous hearts. The evildoers conferred in secret: ‘Is this man anything but a mortal like yourselves? Are you going to fall under his spell with your eyes wide open?’

Dil unke (dusri hi fikron mein) munhamik hain aur zalim aapas mein sargoshiyan(whisper) karte hain ke “yeh shaks aakhir tum jaisa ek bashar (Insaan) hi to hai, phir kya tum aankhon dekhte jaadu ke phanday mein phas jaogey?”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّى يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

translations.text: He said, ‘My Lord knows everything that is said in the heavens and the earth: He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.’
Rasool ne kaha, mera Rubb har us baat ko jaanta hai jo aasman aur zameen mein ki jaye, woh sami(sunne wala) aur aleem (jaanne wala) hai

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَـٰثُ أَحْلَـٰمٍۭ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٍ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ

translations.text: Some say, ‘Muddled dreams’; others, ‘He made it up’; yet others, ‘He is just a poet, let him show us a sign as previous messengers did.’

Woh kehte hain “balke yeh paraganda (incoherent) khwab hai , balke yeh iski mann-ghadath hai, balke yeh shaks shayar hai warna yeh laye koi nishani jis tarah purane zamane ke Rasool nishaniyon ke saath bheje gaye thay”

verses.text_uthmani: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ ۖ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.text: But of the communities We destroyed before them not a single one believed. Will these now believe?
Halaanke inse pehle koi basti bhi, jisey humne halaak kiya, iman na layi, ab kya yeh iman layenge

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: And even before your time [Prophet], all the messengers We sent were only men We inspired–– if you [disbelievers] do not know, ask people who know the Scripture––
Aur (aey Muhammad), tumse pehle bhi humne Insaano hi ko Rasool bana kar bheja tha jinpar hum wahee (revelation) kiya karte thay, Tum log agar ilm nahin rakhte to ehle kitaab se pooch lo

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ جَسَدًا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ خَـٰلِدِينَ

translations.text: We did not give them bodies that ate no food, nor were they immortal.
Un Rasoolon ko humne koi aisa jism nahin diya tha ke woh khate na hon, aur na woh sadaa (hamesha) jeenay waley thay

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ

translations.text: We fulfilled Our promise to them in the end: We saved them and those We wished to save, and We destroyed those who exceeded all bounds.
Phir dekhlo ke aakhir e kaar humne unke saath apne wadey poorey kiye, aur unhein aur jis jis ko humne chaha bacha liya, aur hadd se guzar janey walon ko halaak kardiya

verses.text_uthmani: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَـٰبًا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

translations.text: And now We have sent down to you [people] a Scripture to remind you. Will you not use your reason?
Logon, humne tumhari taraf ek aisi kitaab bheji hai jismein tumhara hi zikr hai, kya tum samajhte nahin ho

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

translations.text: How many communities of evildoers We have destroyed! How many others We have raised up in their places!
Kitni hi zalim bastiyan hain jinko humne pees kar rakh diya aur unke baad dusri kisi qaum ko uthaya

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّوا۟ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ

translations.text: When they felt Our might coming upon them, see how they tried to escape it!
Jab unko hamara azaab mehsoos hua to lagey wahan se bhaagne

verses.text_uthmani: لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَـٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ

translations.text: ‘Do not try to escape. Go back to your homes and the pleasure you revelled in: you may be questioned.’
(kaha gaya) “bhaago nahin, jao apne unhi gharon mein aur aesh ke samaano mein jinke andar tum chain kar rahey thay, shayad ke tumse poocha jaye”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ

translations.text: They said, ‘Woe to us! We were wrong!’
Kehne lagey “haye hamari kambakhti, beshak hum khatawaar thay”

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَـٰمِدِينَ

translations.text: and that cry of theirs did not cease until We made them burnt-offstubble.
Aur woh yahi pukarte rahey yahan tak ke humne unko khalyan (threshed/field that is reaped) kardiya , zindagi ka ek sharara tak unmein na raha (leaving no spark of life in them)

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ

translations.text: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything between them playfully.
Humne is aasman aur zameen ko aur jo kuch bhi inmein hai kuch khel ke taur par nahin banaya hai

verses.text_uthmani: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَّٱتَّخَذْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ

translations.text: If We had wished for a pastime, We could have found it within Us- if We had wished for any such thing.
Agar hum koi khilona banan chahte aur bas yahi kuch humein karna hota to apne hi paas se kar letey

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَـٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ ۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ

translations.text: No! We hurl the truth against falsehood, and truth obliterates it- see how falsehood vanishes away! Woe to you [people] for the way you describe God!
Magar hum to baatil par haqq ki chot lagate hain jo uska sar todh deti hai aur woh dekhte dekhte mitt jata hai, aur tumhare liye tabahi hai un baaton ki wajah se jo tum banate ho

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ

translations.text: Everyone in the heavens and earth belongs to Him, and those that are with Him are never too proud to worship Him, nor do they grow weary;
Zameen aur aasmano mein jo makhlooq bhi hai Allah ki hai aur jo (Farishtey) uske paas hain woh na apne aap ko bada samajh kar uski bandagi se sartabi karte hain aur na malool (weary /tire) hotey hain

verses.text_uthmani: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ

translations.text: they glorify Him tirelessly night and day.
Shab-o-roz uski tasbeeh karte rehte hain, dum nahin letey

verses.text_uthmani: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ

translations.text: Have they chosen any gods from the earth who can give life to the dead?
Kya in logon ke banaye huey arzi khuda aisey hain ke (be-jaan ko jaan baksh kar) utha khada karte hon

verses.text_uthmani: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

translations.text: If there had been in the heavens or earth any gods but Him, both heavens and earth would be in ruins: God, Lord of the Throne, is far above the things they say:
Agar aasman o zameen mein ek Allah ke siwa dusre khuda bhi hotey to (zameen aur aasman) dono ka nizam bigad jata. Pas paak hai Allah Rabbul arsh un baaton se jo yeh log bana rahey hain

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْـَٔلُونَ

translations.text: He cannot be called to account for anything He does, whereas they will be called to account.
Woh apne kaamon ke liye (kisi ke aagey) jawab-de nahin hai aur sab jawab-de hain

verses.text_uthmani: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً ۖ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ ۖ هَـٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِى ۗ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ

translations.text: Have they chosen to worship other gods instead of Him? Say, ‘Bring your proof. This is the Scripture for those who are with me and the Scripture for those who went before me.’ But most of them do not recognize the truth, so they pay no heed.

Kya usey chodh kar inhon ne dusre khuda bana liye hain? (Aey Muhammad) inse kaho ke “lao apni daleel,yeh kitaab bhi maujood hai jismein mere daur ke logon ke liye naseehat hai aur woh kitaabein bhi maujood hain jin mein mujhse pehle logon ke liye naseehat thi” magar un mein se aksar log haqeeqat se bekhabar hain, is liye mooh moadey huey hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ

translations.text: We never sent any messenger before you [Muhammad] without revealing to him: ‘There is no god but Me, so serve Me.’
Humne tumse pehle jo Rasool bhi bheja hai usko yahi wahee ki hai ke mere siwa koi khuda nahin hai, pas tumlog meri hi bandagi karo

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًا ۗ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ ۚ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُونَ

translations.text: And they say, ‘The Lord of Mercy has taken offspring for Himself.’ May He be exalted! No! They are only His honoured servants:
Yeh kehte hain “rehman aulad rakhta hai” SubhanAllah , woh to banday hain jinhein izzat di gayi hai

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِۦ يَعْمَلُونَ

translations.text: they do not speak before He speaks and they act by His command.
Uske huzoor badh kar nahin bolte aur bas uske hukum par amal karte hain

verses.text_uthmani: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِۦ مُشْفِقُونَ

translations.text: He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede without His permission––indeed they themselves stand in awe of Him.

Jo kuch unke saamne hai usey bhi woh jaanta hai aur jo kuch unse ojhal hai ussey bhi woh bakhabar hai, woh kisi ki sifarish nahin karte bajuz uske jiske haqq mein sifarish sunne par Allah raazi ho, aur woh uske khauf se darey rehte hain

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّىٓ إِلَـٰهٌ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

translations.text: If any of them were to claim, ‘I am a god beside Him,’ We would reward them with Hell: this is how We reward evildoers.
Aur jo unmein se koi kehde ke Allah ke siwa main bhi ek khuda hoon, to usey hum jahannum ki saza dein, hamare haan zaalimon ka yahi badla hai

verses.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَـٰهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ ۖ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.text: Are the disbelievers not aware that the heavens and the earth used to be joined together and that We ripped them apart, that We made every living thing from water? Will they not believe?

Kya yeh log jinhon ne (Nabi ki baat maanney se) inkar kardiya hai gaur nahin karte ke yeh sab aasman aur zameen baham miley huey thay, phir humne inhein juda kiya, aur pani se har zinda cheez paida ki, kya woh (hamari is khallaqi ko) nahin maante

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ

translations.text: And We put firm mountains on the earth, lest it should sway under them, and set broad paths on it, so that they might follow the right direction,
Aur humne zameen mein pahad jamaa diye taa-ke woh unhein lekar dhulak na jaye, aur ismein kushada raahein bana di, shayad ke log apna raasta maloom karlein

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقْفًا مَّحْفُوظًا ۖ وَهُمْ عَنْ ءَايَـٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ

translations.text: and We made the sky a well-secured canopy- yet from its wonders they turn away.
Aur humne aasman ko ek mehfooz chatt bana diya, magar ye hain ke iski nishaniyon ki taraf tawajju hi nahin karte

verses.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ

translations.text: It is He who created night and day, the sun and the moon, each floating in its orbit.
Aur woh Allah hi hai jisne raat aur din banaye aur Suraj aur Chand ko paida kiya, sab ek ek falak mein tair rahey hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ ۖ أَفَإِي۟ن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِدُونَ

translations.text: We have not granted everlasting life to any other human being before you either [Muhammad]- if you die, will [the disbelievers] live for ever?
Aur (aey Muhammad), hameshgi(eternity) to humne tumse pehle bhi kisi Insaan ke liye nahin rakkhi hai agar tum mar gaye to kya yeh log hamesha jeetay rahenge

verses.text_uthmani: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۗ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً ۖ وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ

translations.text: Every soul is certain to taste death: We test you all through the bad and the good, and to Us you will all return.
Har jaandaar ko maut ka maza chakhna hai, aur hum acchey aur burey halaat mein daal kar tum sabki aazmaish kar rahey hain, aakhir-e-kaar tumhein hamari hi taraf palatna hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَذْكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ هُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ

translations.text: When the disbelievers see you, they laugh at you: ‘Is this the one who talks about your gods?’ They reject any talk of the Lord of Mercy.

Yeh munkireen e haqq jab tumhein dekhte hain to tumhara mazaaq bana letey hain. Kehte hain “kya yeh hai woh shaks jo tumhare khudaon ka zikr kiya karta hai?” aur inka apna haal yeh hai ke rehman ke zikr se munkir hain

verses.text_uthmani: خُلِقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِنْ عَجَلٍ ۚ سَأُو۟رِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِى فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ

translations.text: Man was created hasty: I will show you My signs soon, so do not ask Me to hasten them.
Insaan jald baaz makhlooq hai, abhi main tumko apni nishaniyan dikhaye deta hoon, jaldi na machao

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

translations.text: They say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, if what you say is true?’
Yeh log kehte hain “aakhir yeh dhamki poori kab hogi agar tum sacchey ho”

verses.text_uthmani: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

translations.text: If the disbelievers only knew, the time will arrive when they will not be able to ward off the Fire from their faces or their backs, and they will get no help.
Kaash in kaafiron ko us waqt ka kuch ilam hota jabke yeh na apne mooh aag se bacha sakenge na apni peethein, aur na inko kahin se madad pahunchegi

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ تَأْتِيهِم بَغْتَةً فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ

translations.text: It will come upon them suddenly and stupefy them; they will be powerless to push it away; they will not be reprieved.
Woh balaa (catastrophe) achanak aayegi aur inhein is tarah yaklakht (suddenly) daboch legi ke yeh na usko dafaa kar sakenge aur na inko lamha bhar mohlat hi mil sakegi

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

translations.text: Messengers before you [Muhammad] were also ridiculed, but those who mocked them were overwhelmed in the end by the very thing they had mocked.
Mazaaq tumse pehle bhi Rasoolon ka udaya jaa chuka hai, magar unka mazaaq udane waley usi cheez ke pher mein aa kar rahey jiska woh mazaaq udatey thay

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۗ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ

translations.text: Say, ‘Who could protect you night and day from the Lord of Mercy?’ Yet they turn away when their Lord is mentioned.
(Aey Muhammad), insey kaho, “kaun hai jo raat ko ya din ko tumhein rehman se bacha sakta ho?” magar yeh apne Rubb ki naseehat se mooh moad rahey hain

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌ تَمْنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَا ۚ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ

translations.text: Do they have gods who can defend them against Us? Their gods have no power to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
Kya yeh kuch aise khuda rakhte hain jo hamare muqable mein inki himayat karein? Woh na to khud apni madad kar sakte hain aur na hamari hi taaeed unko haasil hai

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ ۗ أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَآ ۚ أَفَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ

translations.text: We have allowed these sinners and their forefathers to enjoy life for a long time. But do they not see how We are shrinking their borders? Is it they who will prevail?

Asal baat yeh hai ke in logon ko aur inke aabaa o ajdaad (fore-fathers) ko hum zindagi ka sar o saamaan diye chale gaye yahan tak ke inko din lag gaye (until the period grew too long for them). Magar kya inhein nazar nahin aata ke hum zameen ko mukhtalif simton se ghataye chale aa rahey hain (shrinking its boundaries)? Phir kya yeh gaalib aa jayenge

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلْوَحْىِ ۚ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ

translations.text: Say, ‘I warn you only through the Revelation.’ The deaf will not hear the warning call,
Inse kehdo ke “main to wahee (revelation) ki bina par tumhein mutanabbeh (warn) kar raha hoon”. Magar behre pukaar ko nahin suna karte jabke unhein khabardaar kiya jaye

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ

translations.text: yet if a mere breath of your Lord’s punishment touches them, they will be sure to cry, ‘Woe to us! We were wrong!’
Aur agar tere Rubb ka azaab zara sa inhein choo jaye to abhi cheekh utthein ke haaye hamari kambakhti, beshak hum khatawaar thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَضَعُ ٱلْمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَـٰسِبِينَ

translations.text: We will set up scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection so that no one can be wronged in the least, and if there should be even the weight of a mustard seed, We shall bring it out- We take excellent account.

Qayamat ke roz hum theek theek toalne waley tarazu rakh dengey, phir kisi shaks par zarra barabar zulm na hoga. Jiska rai (mustard seed) ke daane ke barabar bhi kuch kiya dhara hoga woh hum saamne le aayenge aur hisaab lagane ke liye hum kafi hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءً وَذِكْرًا لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ

translations.text: We gave Moses and Aaron [the Scripture] that distinguishes right from wrong, a light and a reminder for those who are mindful of God,
Pehle hum Moosa aur Haroon ko furqan(criteria) aur roshni aur “zikr” ata kar chuke hain un muttaqi logon ki bhalayi ke liye

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ

translations.text: those who stand in awe of their Lord, though He is unseen, and who fear the Hour.
Jo bay-dekhe (bagair dekhe) apne Rubb se darein aur jinko (hisaab ki) us ghadi ka khatka laga hua hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَهَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ ۚ أَفَأَنتُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ

translations.text: This [Quran] too is a blessed message We have sent down- are you [people] going to deny it?
Aur ab yeh ba-barakat “zikr” humne (tumhare liye) nazil kiya hai phir kya tum isko qabool karne se inkaari ho

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ رُشْدَهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَـٰلِمِينَ

translations.text: Long ago We bestowed right judgement on Abraham and We knew him well.
Ussey bhi pehle humne Ibrahim ko uski hosh-mandi bakshi thi aur hum usko khoob jantey thay

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَـٰكِفُونَ

translations.text: He said to his father and his people, ‘What are these images to which you are so devoted?’
Yaad karo woh mauqa ke usne apne baap aur apni qaum se kaha tha ke “yeh muratein (images) kaisi hain jinke tumlog girwida (devoted) ho rahey ho?”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَـٰبِدِينَ

translations.text: They replied, ‘We found our fathers worshipping them.’
Unhon ne jawab diya “humne apne baap dada ko inki ibadat karte paya hai”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.text: He said, ‘You and your fathers have clearly gone astray.’
Usne kaha “tum bhi gumraah ho aur tumhare baap dada bhi sareeh gumaraahi mein paday huey thay?”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّـٰعِبِينَ

translations.text: They asked, ‘Have you brought us the truth or are you just playing about?’
Unhon ne kaha “kya tu hamare samne apne asli khayalaat pesh kar raha hai ya mazaaq karta hai?”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ

translations.text: He said, ‘Listen! Your true Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, He who created them, and I am a witness to this.
Usne jawab diya “nahin, balke fil waqey tumhara Rubb wahi hai jo zameen aur aasmano ka Rubb aur unka paida karne wala hai, ispar main tumhare samne gawahi deta hoon

verses.text_uthmani: وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَـٰمَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ

translations.text: By God I shall certainly plot against your idols as soon as you have turned your backs!’
Aur khuda ki kasam main tumhari gair maujoodgi mein zaroor tumhare buthon (idols/murtiyon) ki khabar lunga”

verses.text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ

translations.text: He broke them all into pieces, but left the biggest one for them to return to.
Chunanchey usne unko tukde tukde kardiya aur sirf unke baday ko chodh diya taa-ke shayad woh iski taraf rujoo karein

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ مَن فَعَلَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

translations.text: They said, ‘Who has done this to our gods? How wicked he must be!’
Unhon ne aakar buthon[idols] ka yeh haal dekha to) kehne lagey “hamare khudaon ka yeh haal kisne kardiya? Bada hi koi zalim tha woh”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ

translations.text: Some said, ‘We heard a youth called Abraham talking about them.’
(baaz log) boley “ humne ek nawjawan ko inka zikr karte suna tha jiska naam Ibrahim hai”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ فَأْتُوا۟ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ

translations.text: They said, ‘Bring him before the eyes of the people, so that they may witness [his trial].’
Unhon ne kaha “ to pakad lao usey sabke samne taa-ke log dekh lein (uski kaisi khabar li jati hai)”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ

translations.text: They asked, ‘Was it you, Abraham, who did this to our gods?’
(Ibrahim ke aane par) unhon ne pucha “kyun Ibrahim, tu nay hamare khudaon ke saath yeh harakat ki hai

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَـٰذَا فَسْـَٔلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ يَنطِقُونَ

translations.text: He said, ‘No, it was done by the biggest of them- this one. Ask them, if they can talk.’
Usne jawab diya “balke yeh sab kuch inke is sardar ne kiya hai, inhi se pooch lo agar yeh bolte hon”

verses.text_uthmani: فَرَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ

translations.text: They turned to one another, saying, ‘It is you who are in the wrong,’
Yeh sunkar woh log apne zameer ki taraf palte aur (apne dilon mein) kehne lagey “waqayi tum khud hi zalim ho”

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ

translations.text: but then they lapsed again and said, ‘You know very well these gods cannot speak.’
Magar phir unki math palat gayi(minds became perverse) aur boley “ tu jaanta hai ke yeh bolte nahin hain”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ

translations.text: Abraham said, ‘How can you worship what can neither benefit nor harm you, instead of God?
Ibrahim ne kaha “phir kya tum Allah ko chodh kar un cheezon ko poojh rahey ho jo na tumhein nafaa pahunchane par qadir hain na nuqsan

verses.text_uthmani: أُفٍّ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

translations.text: Shame on you and on the things you worship instead of God. Have you no sense?’
Tuff (Fie) hai tumpar aur tumhare in maboodon par jinki tum Allah ko chodh kar pooja kar rahey ho, kya tum kuch bhi aqal nahin rakhte?”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ

translations.text: They said, ‘Burn him and avenge your gods, if you are going to do the right thing.’
Unhon ne kaha “jala daalo isko aur himayat karo apne khudaon ki agar tumhein kuch karna hai”

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ

translations.text: But We said, ‘Fire, be cool and safe for Abraham.’
Humne kaha “Aey aag, thandi ho jaa aur salamati ban jaa Ibrahim par”

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ

translations.text: They planned to harm him, but We made them suffer the greatest loss.
Woh chahte thay ke Ibrahim ke saath burayi karein magar humne unko buri tarah nakaam kardiya

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

translations.text: We saved him and Lot [and sent them] to the land We blessed for all people,
Aur hum usey aur Lut ko bacha kar us sar-zameen ki taraf nikal le gaye jismein humne duniya walon ke liye barkatein rakkhi hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةً ۖ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صَـٰلِحِينَ

translations.text: and We gave him Isaac and Jacob as an additional gift, and made each of them righteous.
Aur humne usey Ishaq ata kiya aur Yakoob uspar mazeed, aur har ek ko saleh (righteous) banaya

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا عَـٰبِدِينَ

translations.text: We made all of them leaders, guiding others by Our command, and We inspired them to do good works, to keep up the prayer, and to give alms: they were Our true worshippers.

Aur humne unko imam bana diya jo hamare hukum se rehnumayi karte thay aur humne unhein wahee (revelation) ke zariye neik kaamon ki aur namaz qayam karne ki aur zakat dene ki hidayat ki, aur woh hamare ibadat guzaar thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَت تَّعْمَلُ ٱلْخَبَـٰٓئِثَ ۗ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَـٰسِقِينَ

translations.text: We gave Lot sound judgement and knowledge and saved him from the community who practised obscenities- they were shameless people who broke God’s law!
Aur Lut ko humne hukum aur ilm baksha aur usey us basti se bacha kar nikal diya jo badkariyan karti thi. Dar haqeeqat woh badi hi buri, fasiq qaum thi

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

translations.text: We admitted him to Our mercy; he was a righteous man.
Aur Lut ko humne apni rehmat mein dakhil kiya, woh saleh logon mein se tha

verses.text_uthmani: وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

translations.text: Long before that, We answered Noah when he cried out to Us: We saved him and his family from the great calamity
Aur yahi niyamat humne Nooh ko di, yaad karo jabke in sab se pehle usne humein pukara tha, humne uski dua qabool ki aur usey aur uske ghar walon ko karb-e-azeem (great calamity) se najaat di

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.text: and We helped him against the people who rejected Our signs- they were evil people, so We drowned them all.
Aur us qaum ke muqaable mein uski madad ki jisne hamari aayat ko jhutla diya tha. Woh baday burey log thay, pas humne un sabko garq (drown) kardiya

verses.text_uthmani: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِى ٱلْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَـٰهِدِينَ

translations.text: And remember David and Solomon, when they gave judgement regarding the field into which sheep strayed by night and grazed. We witnessed their judgement

Aur isi niyamat se humne Dawood aur Suleiman ko sarfaraz kiya. Yaad karo woh mauqa jabke woh dono ek khet (field) ke muqaddame mein faisla kar rahey thay jismein raat ke waqt dusre logon ki bakriyan(goats) phayl gayi thin (strayed at night),aur hum unki adalat khud dekh rahey thay

verses.text_uthmani: فَفَهَّمْنَـٰهَا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا ۚ وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ ٱلْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَٱلطَّيْرَ ۚ وَكُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ

translations.text: and made Solomon understand the case [better], though We gave sound judgement and knowledge to both of them. We made the mountains and the birds celebrate Our praises with David- We did all these things-

Us waqt humne sahih faisla Sulaiman ko samjha diya, halaanke hukum aur ilm humne dono hi ko ata kiya tha. Dawood ke saath humne pahadon aur parindon ko musakkhar kardiya tha jo tasbeeh karte thay, is fail (kaam) ke karne waley hum hi thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأْسِكُمْ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُمْ شَـٰكِرُونَ

translations.text: We taught him how to make coats of mail for the benefit of you [people], to protect you in your wars, but are you grateful for this?
Aur humne usko tumhare faiyde ke liye zira (coats of armor) banane ki sanat (craft) sikha di thi, taa-ke tumko ek dusre ki maar se bachaye, phir kya tum shukar guzar ho

verses.text_uthmani: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ

translations.text: We harnessed the stormy wind for Solomon, so that it sped by his command to the land We had blessed- We have knowledge of all things-
Aur Sulaiman ke liye humne teiz hawa ko musakkhar kardiya tha jo uske hukum se us sar-zameen ki taraf chalti thi jismein humne barkatein rakkhi hain. Hum har cheez ka ilm rakhne waley thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ

translations.text: and We made some of the jinn subservient to him, to dive for him and do other works besides. We were watching over them.
Aur shayateen mein se humne aisey bahutson (many) ko uska tabey bana diya tha jo uske liye ghotey (diving) lagate aur iske siwa dusre kaam karte thay, in sab ke nigraan hum hi thay

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

translations.text: Remember Job, when he cried to his Lord, ‘Suffering has truly afflicted me, but you are the Most Merciful of the merciful.’

Aur yahi (hosh-mandi aur hukum o ilm ki niyamat) humne Ayub ko di thi. Yaad karo jabke usne apne Rubb ko pukara ke “mujhey bimaari lag gayi hai aur tu arham ur rahimeen (sab se badhkar reham karne wala) hai.”

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرٍّ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَـٰبِدِينَ

translations.text: We answered him, removed his suffering, and restored his family to him, along with more like them, as an act of grace from Us and a reminder for all who serve Us.

Humne uski dua qabool ki aur jo takleef usey thi usko door kardiya, aur sirf uske ehl-o-ayal hi usko nahin diye balke unke saath utne hi aur bhi diye, apni khaas rehmat ke taur par, aur isliye ke yeh ek sabaq ho ibadat guzaaron keliye

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ

translations.text: And remember Ishmael, Idris, and Dhu’l-Kifl: they were all steadfast.
Aur yahi niyamat Ismail aur Idris(Enoch) aur Dhul-Kifl (Isaiah) ko di, ke yeh sab saabir log (practised fortitude) thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

translations.text: We admitted them to Our mercy; they were truly righteous.
Aur unko humne apni rehmat mein dakhil kiya ke woh salihon (righteous people) mein se thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَـٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

translations.text: And remember the man with the whale,when he went off angrily, thinking We could not restrict him, but then he cried out in the deep darkness, ‘There is no God but You, glory be to You, I was wrong.’

Aur machli waley(yunus) ko bhi humne nawaza, yaad karo jabke woh bigad kar chala gaya tha aur samjha tha ke hum uspar giraft na karenge. Aakhir ko usne tareekiyon(darkness) mein pukara “nahin hai koi khuda magar tu, paak hai teri zaat, beshak maine kasoor kiya”

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.text: We answered him and saved him from distress: this is how We save the faithful.
Tab humne uski dua qabool ki aur ghum se usko najaat bakshi, aur isi taraah hum momino ko bacha liya karte hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ

translations.text: Remember Zachariah, when he cried to his Lord, ‘My Lord, do not leave me childless, though You are the best of heirs.’
Aur zakariya ko, jabke usne apne Rubb ko pukara ke “aey parwardigar, mujhey akela na chodh, aur behtareen waris to tu hi hai”

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُۥ زَوْجَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًا وَرَهَبًا ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا خَـٰشِعِينَ

translations.text: We answered him––We gave him John, and cured his wife of barrenness- they were always keen to do good deeds. They called upon Us out of longing and awe, and humbled themselves before Us.

Pas humne uski dua qabool ki aur usey Yahya ata kiya aur uski biwi ko uske liye durust kardiya, yeh log neki ke kaamon mein daud-dhoop karte thay aur humein ragbat (with love) aur khauf ke saath pukarte thay, aur hamare aagey jhuke huey thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا وَٱبْنَهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

translations.text: Remember the one who guarded her chastity. We breathed into her from Our Spirit and made her and her son a sign for all people.
Aur woh khaatun jisne apni ismat (chastity) ki hifazat ki thi, humne uske andar apni rooh se phoonka aur usey aur uske bete ko duniya bhar ke liye nishani bana diya

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُونِ

translations.text: [Messengers], this community of yours is one single community and I am your Lord, so serve Me.
Yeh tumhari ummat haqeeqat mein ek hi ummat hai aur main tumhara Rubb hoon, pas tum meri ibadat karo

verses.text_uthmani: وَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَٰجِعُونَ

translations.text: They have torn their unity apart, but they will all return to Us.
Magar (yeh logon ki karastani hai ke) inhon ne aapas mein deen ko tukde tukde kar dala, sabko hamari taraf palatna hai

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ كَـٰتِبُونَ

translations.text: If anyone does good deeds and is a believer, his efforts will not be ignored: We record them for him.
Phir jo neik amal karega, is haal mein ke woh momin ho, to uske kaam ki na-qadri na hogi, aur usey hum likh rahey hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَحَرَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ

translations.text: No community destroyed by Us can escape its return,
Aur mumkin nahin hai ke jis basti ko humne halaak kardiya ho woh phir palat sakey

verses.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنسِلُونَ

translations.text: and when the peoples of Gog and Magog are let loose and swarm swiftly from every highland,
Yahaan tak ke jab yajooj majooj khol diye jayenge aur har bulandi se woh nikal padenge

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱقْتَرَبَ ٱلْوَعْدُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِىَ شَـٰخِصَةٌ أَبْصَـٰرُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ

translations.text: when the True Promise draws near, the disbelievers’ eyes will stare in terror, and they will say, ‘Woe to us! We were not aware of this at all. We were wrong.’

Aur wada bar haqq ke poora hone ka waqt qareeb aa lagega to yakayak un logon ke deedhey phatey ke phatey reh jayenge (fixedly stare in horror), jinhon ne kufr kiya tha. Kahenge “haaye hamari kambakhti, hum is cheez ki taraf se gaflat mein padey huey thay, balke hum khatakaar thay.”

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُمْ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ

translations.text: You [disbelievers] and what you worship instead of God will be fuel for Hell: that is where you will go-
Beshak tum aur tumhare woh mabood jinhein tum poojhte ho, jahannum ka indhan (fuel) hain, wahin tumko jana hai

verses.text_uthmani: لَوْ كَانَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ءَالِهَةً مَّا وَرَدُوهَا ۖ وَكُلٌّ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ

translations.text: if these [idols] had been real gods they would not have gone there- you will all stay there.
Agar yeh waqayi khuda hotey to wahan na jatey, ab sabko hamesha usi mein rehna hai.”

verses.text_uthmani: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ

translations.text: There the disbelievers will be groaning piteously, but the [idols] will hear nothing.
Wahaan woh phunkare maarenge (groan/roar) aur haal yeh hoga ke usmein kaan padi aawaaz na sunayi degi

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُم مِّنَّا ٱلْحُسْنَىٰٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ

translations.text: But those for whom We have decreed Paradise will be kept far from Hell-
Rahey woh log jinke liye hamari taraf se bhalayi ka pehle hi faisla ho chuka hoga, to woh yaqeenan ussey door rakkhey jayenge

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا ۖ وَهُمْ فِى مَا ٱشْتَهَتْ أَنفُسُهُمْ خَـٰلِدُونَ

translations.text: they will not hear a murmur from it- and endlessly they will enjoy everything their souls desire.
Uski sarsarahat tak na sunenge aur woh hamesha hamesha apni mann bhati cheezon ke darmiyan rahenge

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ ٱلْفَزَعُ ٱلْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ هَـٰذَا يَوْمُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ

translations.text: They will have no fear of the great Terror: the angels will receive them with the words, ‘This is the Day you were promised!’
Woh intihayi ghabrahat ka waqt unko zara pareshan na karega, aur malaika badh kar unko haathon haath lenge ke “yeh tumhara wahi din hai jiska tumse waada kiya jaata tha”

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ نَطْوِى ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَىِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ ۚ كَمَا بَدَأْنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُّعِيدُهُۥ ۚ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ

translations.text: On that Day, We shall roll up the skies as a writer rolls up [his] scrolls. We shall reproduce creation just as We produced it the first time: this is Our binding promise. We shall certainly do all these things.

Woh din jabke aasman ko hum yun lapeit kar rakh denge jaise tumar mein awraaq lapeit diye jatey hain (leaves of paper are rolled up in a written scroll) jis tarah pehle humne takhleeq ki ibtida ki thi usi tarah hum phir uska iaada (originate) karenge. Yeh ek wada hai hamare zimme, aur yeh kaam humein bahr-haal karna hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِى ٱلزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلذِّكْرِ أَنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِىَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ

translations.text: We wrote in the Psalms, as We did in [earlier] Scripture: ‘My righteous servants will inherit the earth.’
Aur Zaboor mein hum naseehat ke baad yeh likh chuke hain ke zameen ke waris hamare neik banday hongey

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى هَـٰذَا لَبَلَـٰغًا لِّقَوْمٍ عَـٰبِدِينَ

translations.text: There truly is a message in this for the servants of God!
Is mein ek badi khabar hai ibadat guzar logon ke liye

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

translations.text: It was only as a mercy that We sent you [Prophet] to all people.
(Aey Muhammad), humne jo tumko bheja hai to yeh dar-asal duniya walon ke haqq mein hamari rehmat hai

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ

translations.text: Say, ‘What is revealed to me is that your God is one God- will you submit to Him?’
Insey kaho, “mere paas jo wahee aati hai woh yeh hai ke tumhara khuda sirf ek khuda hai, phir kya tum sar-e-itaat jhukate ho?”

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُلْ ءَاذَنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍ ۖ وَإِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ أَم بَعِيدٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ

translations.text: But if they turn away, say, ‘I have proclaimed the message fairly to you all. I do not know whether the judgement you are promised is near or far,
Agar woh mooh pherein to kehdo “maine alal-ailaan (openly) tumko khabardaar kardiya hai. Ab yeh main nahin jaanta ke woh cheez jiska tumse wada kiya jaa raha hai qareeb hai ya door

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ

translations.text: but He knows what you reveal and conceal.
Allah woh baatein bhi jaanta hai jo ba-awaaz buland kahi jati hain aur woh bhi jo tum chupa kar karte ho

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنْ أَدْرِى لَعَلَّهُۥ فِتْنَةٌ لَّكُمْ وَمَتَـٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ

translations.text: I do not know: this [time] may well be a test for you, and enjoyment for a while.’
Main to yeh samajhta hoon ke shayad yeh (dair/delay) tumhare liye ek fitna hai aur tumhein ek waqt e khaas tak ke liye mazay karne ka mauqa diya jaa raha hai”

verses.text_uthmani: قَـٰلَ رَبِّ ٱحْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ

translations.text: He said,‘My Lord, pass the true judgement.’ And, ‘Our Lord is the Lord of Mercy. We seek His assistance against what you [disbelievers] say.’
(aakhi-e-kaar) Rasool ne kaha “aey mere Rubb, haqq ke saath faisla karde, aur logon, tum jo baatein banate ho unke muqable mein hamara Rubb-e-Rehman hi hamare liye madad ka sahara hai.”
